# Contributing

Contribtions to this project are released to the public under the project's open source license. By participating in this project you agree to abide by its terms.

## Submitting a pull request

1. Fork and clone the repository `git clone https://github.com/SycoMetrix/SycoMetrix.git`
2. Create a new branch `git checkout -b some-branch-name`
3. Create the necessary changes, add tests, and ensure tests pass
4. Push the fork `git push origin some-branch-name`
5. Submit a pull request
6. Wait for the pull request to be reviewed and merged
